summary: ING Groep N.V. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release providing a weekly update on its ongoing share buyback programme. The programme, announced on 30 October 2025, has a maximum total value of approximately €1.1 billion. During the week of 20-24 April 2026, ING repurchased 1,358,806 shares at an average price of €24.06, for a total of €32,694,625.98. Cumulative repurchases stand at 46,660,057 shares at an average price of €23.46, representing about 99.49% completion. The buyback aims to reduce share capital. As a routine progress report on a capital return programme, this filing is classified as Capital Returns. No board recommendation, advisor, or unusual structural terms are mentioned. What to watch: programme likely to conclude imminently, with no risk-arb angle as it is an issuer buyback.
